tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d
tasks.prompt: The Scanbay 2 design files show the next location on the pick screen in smaller text than the written requirements ask for. The designers will not update the files for another month. May the developers build the pick screen to the text size the written requirements give, without waiting for the design files to change?
tasks.notes: Yes: the requirements document wins over the design files until the design is updated.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d
tasks.prompt: Night staff in Lyon complain about the scan tones. May the shift lead lower the scan volume for the whole Lyon centre to 50% for the night shift?
tasks.notes: Yes: sound cannot be turned off, but a shift lead may lower the volume for a whole centre at night down to a 40% floor; 50% is above it.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d
tasks.prompt: During receiving, the barcode on a supplier's pallet label is torn and will not scan. May the receiver key in the serial number printed under the barcode instead?
tasks.notes: Yes: keying is allowed for pallet labels, and it is logged as a manual entry.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d
tasks.prompt: A putaway operator wants to store a boxed item that weighs 22 kg and is 1.8 metres long in its packaging at an empty location on the third beam level of racking. The location's weight and height limits are not exceeded and its zone accepts the item's storage class. May the item go there?
tasks.notes: Yes: the item is not bulky (bulky means over 30 kg or longer than 2.4 m), so the first-beam rule does not apply.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d
tasks.prompt: A putaway operator is in a dead zone with no network. May they confirm the putaway of a pallet to the location the app suggested for that task?
tasks.notes: Yes, cross-section (Putaway and Working offline): the suggested location was confirmed by WMS when the task was created, and putaway to it works offline.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d
tasks.prompt: A picker is picking a five-carton wardrobe and finds that carton 4 of 5 is crushed. May the picker pick the other four cartons and report only carton 4 as short?

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d
tasks.prompt: On a quiet night shift only one picker is working in an aisle, and a hand-picked line includes a carton flagged as two-person lift. May the shift lead approve the picker confirming that line alone?

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d
tasks.prompt: A picker still has three lines open on a pick list, and the shift lead releases them from the unfinished list. May the picker now start a new pick list without dropping the old one at a drop location?
tasks.notes: Yes: the shift lead release is the stated exception; the remaining lines go back to WMS.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d
tasks.prompt: May the Scanbay 2 pick screen show a picker their own pick rate for the shift together with the target rate for their task type?
tasks.notes: Yes: own rate and target rate are allowed; comparison with other workers is not.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d
tasks.prompt: A loader has scanned the dock door and the app is now waiting for the trailer barcode, which is a QR code. Will Scanbay 2 accept the QR code scan at this step?
tasks.notes: Yes: QR codes are accepted only, and exactly, when the app is waiting for a trailer scan.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d
tasks.prompt: A supplier pallet label carries an SSCC, a GTIN, a count of contained items and a best-before date in an application identifier Scanbay 2 does not parse. Is the label accepted?
tasks.notes: Yes: only a missing SSCC (identifier 00) causes rejection; unknown identifiers are ignored and logged.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d

tasks.notes: Yes: the charging cradle is the exception; the device keeps sending the queue from the cradle.

tasks.prompt: How far may a handheld's clock drift from network time before the device stops accepting scans?

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d
tasks.prompt: Which two distribution centres do not handle customer returns in Scanbay 2?

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d
tasks.prompt: Summarise in a few sentences the rules Scanbay 2 applies to cartons flagged as two-person lift, including when the second person's badge scan is and is not needed and who can change that.

rubric.text: A carton is two-person lift when it weighs over 25 kg in a single carton.
The line cannot be confirmed until a second worker scans their badge on the same device; this covers pick, putaway and loading.
No setting, override or shift lead approval removes the second badge scan, and no code path, flag, test bypass or debug option may let a single badge confirm it, even in test builds.
The only exception is a line WMS marks as a forklift pick, and the scan is skipped for that line only.

tasks.notes: Cross-section: Picking (two-person lift) and the notes for automated coding assistants.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d
tasks.prompt: Explain how the handheld's offline queue works: how much it holds, what happens as it fills, and what the worker can and cannot do while it holds unsent entries.

rubric.text: The queue holds up to 1,000 entries or 4 hours of work, whichever comes first (not the older 200 scan limit).
Each damage photo counts as 10 entries.
At 80% of either limit the worker gets a warning banner, and at 100% the app stops accepting scans and shows SB-202.
A worker cannot sign out while the queue holds entries, except by putting the device in a charging cradle, where it keeps sending.
Entries WMS rejects are not retried; they go to the shift lead's exceptions list with WMS's reason.

tasks.notes: Cross-section: Working offline and the Decisions section (queue size).

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d
tasks.prompt: Summarise how a cycle count and any variance it finds are handled, from the counter scanning the location to the stock being adjusted.

rubric.text: Counts are blind: the counter never sees the expected quantity, not even as an option for shift leads.
A variance of no more than 2% of the expected quantity and no more than 5 units is accepted automatically; otherwise a different counter recounts without being told.
If the recount confirms the variance, a shift lead approves it up to 2,000 euros of stock value and a warehouse admin above that.
The location is locked for picking and putaway during the count for at most 30 minutes, after which the task goes back to the queue.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d
tasks.prompt: Operations want shift leads to be able to approve damage write-offs up to 1,000 euros per item instead of the current limit, and the other write-offs that follow the same limit should keep following it. Which lines of the document must change?
tasks.notes: Cross-section: Users and roles states the limit, Returns applies the same 750 euro limit to grade C write-offs.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d
tasks.prompt: The team decides to raise the offline queue's entry limit to 1,500 entries, keeping the time limit as it is. Which lines of the document must change to state the current requirement?
tasks.notes: Line 312 holds the superseded 200 scan decision, which the document keeps as written; it is not the current requirement.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-d
tasks.prompt: Which lines must change to tighten the scan feedback requirement from 300 ms to 250 ms?
tasks.notes: Physical requirements, performance requirements and the scan test suite all state 300 ms. Line 676 cites 300 ms only as the reason for a past decision.
